title: SMRFORGE evidence envelope v1
description: A signed, independently-verifiable evidence bundle. The signature covers `bundle_sha256`, which is the SHA-256 of the canonical `sha256sums` digest-list -- NOT the section values -- so a section's `value` may be withheld (redacted) while its digest keeps the commitment and the signature stays valid. Semantic rules the SCHEMA cannot express (a withheld section's `value` and its top-level readable copy must both be absent and declared in `redaction.withheld`; each `manifest[s].sha256` must equal `sha256sums[s]` and, when present, `sha256(canon(value))`; `bundle_sha256 == sha256(canon(sha256sums))`) are enforced by the verifier, not this document.

digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 with a `sha256:` prefix.

value.description: The section contents. ABSENT when the section is redacted; still pinned by `sha256`.

result.description: Readable copy of the result section. Absent when `result` is withheld.

reproducibility.description: Readable copy of the provenance section (code_version, data_library, rng_seed, ...). Absent when `provenance` is withheld.

manifest.description: Per-section digest + value. Value is absent for a redacted section.

sha256sums.description: The SEALED digest-list -- the sole subject of the signature.

host.description: Diagnostic only -- OUTSIDE the seal, never checked by the verifier.

redaction.description: Present on a docket-safe redacted derivative.
